item.title: Festive Vehicle Retail 2026 Hits Record 55.25 Lakh

item.description: India’s automobile retail market recorded its highest-ever 42-day festive sales in 2026, with 55,25,490 vehicles sold, according to data released by the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA). This marked a 2.21% increase over the 54,05,956 units registered during the corresponding festive period in 2025. The industry added 1,19,534 units despite the high base of the previous festive season. Compared to Festive 2024, when retail stood at 44,57,691 units, volumes increased 23.95%, indicating a sustained expansion over two years.
